options.note:
"What is this goofy loadout?"

This is the loadout that allows you to destroy a base and equip a 50 cal gunpod. You can't equip two of the gunpods in a symmetrical manner, because that would exceed the weight limit. But you also can't equip just one gunpod, because that would exceed the weight balance offset. So you equip one gunpod and one 100 lb bomb and make it work.
